title: What If You Stood on Europa's Icy Surface?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Europa? The ocean under the ice is the safe part.
Europa orbits inside Jupiter's radiation belts, so its surface is bombarded by high energy particles.
The European Space Agency says a visitor would take a lethal dose in a matter of hours.
It's worst near the equator, where the radiation chews roughly 10 to 20 centimeters into the ice.
Toward the poles it reaches less than one centimeter, so those regions are gentler.
Even NASA's Europa Clipper carries aluminum armor about one centimeter thick. A person wouldn't last hours.
